propositions: Cloud whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) lack multi-page test coverage despite paginating through opaque nextPageToken cursors at page_size=100
The three readers have no test exercising more than one page; existing coverage feeds only single-page payloads with isLast=True
Termination conditions (isLast=True and null/absent nextPageToken) are never tested independently; either condition alone is vulnerable to regression
A server returning the same non-null nextPageToken causes the readers to spin forever with no guard, converting to silently partial maps via fail-open exception handling
Structural anti-regression guard must be extended to adapters/jira/*.py to prevent unpaginated whole-project readers from being added silently
